title: Dutch Police Arrest Two Over NFC Relay Attacks That Drained $400,000+ From Bank Accounts
description: Dutch police arrested two individuals involved in a bank helpdesk fraud scheme that used NFC relay attacks to steal over $400,000 from 170 victims. The suspects called victims, played AI-generated audio impersonating banks, and persuaded them to install an app to scan their credit cards via NFC. The stolen card data was then used to withdraw money from victims' accounts at ATMs. The suspects were arrested and their infrastructure seized.
